prompt: The bots join the Meta AI Global Hackathon and wins!
title: Hackathon Win
irony: Teddy studies every rule to build a bot that knows everything, yet the team wins the hackathon only by trying an untested dance together.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Teddy, Benny and Vera see the bright hackathon tent flap on the sunny street.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Teddy hugs a big rule book inside the big house and shows Benny the prize trophy nearby.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Sterling rolls in with a shiny speedy chop-bot and taunts Teddy to beat its fast dance.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The kids chant the hackathon cheer around the cluttered table full of wires.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Teddy's fact bot freezes on stage while Vera redraws the plan and Benny spills juice.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Sterling's chop-bot splatters red paint across Benny's face and Teddy shouts the wrong fact.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The kids repeat the hackathon cheer as paint drips from the table edge.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Vera holds the soggy plan and sees perfect notes miss the fun.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Vera tears the perfect plan in half and asks Teddy to try the untested dance idea.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Vera lifts the shared dance-bot trophy high as Sterling claps on the sunny street.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The friends hug beside the bright hackathon tent while the shared trophy gleams in the sun.
